condition: Design audit says not_ready or unresolved blocking issue
families_to_avoid_or_flag: all
notes: Return blocking memo instead of final model recommendation.

condition: Claim is association and DV continuous
recommended_family_ids: linear_ols; linear_hdfe; panel_fe; panel_re_cre; glm_general; fractional_response; beta_regression; two_part_fractional
families_to_avoid_or_flag: iv_control_function; did_event_study unless design warrants
notes: Do not overclaim causality.

condition: DV binary
recommended_family_ids: binary_models; linear_ols as LPM robustness; panel_fe LPM if saturated FE needed
families_to_avoid_or_flag: poisson; nbreg; tobit
notes: Report marginal effects or probabilities.

condition: DV count with many zeros/nonnegative support
families_to_avoid_or_flag: linear_ols only without count robustness
notes: Check exposure/offset and overdispersion.

condition: DV net flow includes negative values
recommended_family_ids: linear_ols; linear_hdfe; panel_fe; transform with documented constant; decompose inflow/outflow and use count models as robustness
families_to_avoid_or_flag: poisson/nbreg on signed net flow
notes: Negative outcomes cannot be modeled directly by standard count models.

condition: Panel data with time-invariant unobserved heterogeneity likely correlated with regressors
families_to_avoid_or_flag: panel_re_cre unless CRE justified; pooled OLS without FE
notes: Check within-unit variation in focal variables.

condition: Time-invariant focal covariate in panel and correlated heterogeneity plausible
families_to_avoid_or_flag: panel_fe as sole model if focal variable absorbed
notes: CRE offers compromise when available.

condition: DID or event-study with common treatment timing
families_to_avoid_or_flag: simple pre/post without controls; cross-sectional treatment effects only
notes: Require pretrends and comparison group.

condition: DID with staggered adoption and heterogeneous treatment effects plausible
recommended_family_ids: did_event_study with heterogeneous/staggered commands; community csdid/eventstudyinteract/did_imputation if approved
families_to_avoid_or_flag: simple TWFE as only main model
notes: TWFE can be misleading under heterogeneous dynamic effects.

condition: Endogenous regressor with credible external instrument
families_to_avoid_or_flag: OLS as causal main model
notes: Require instrument-validity memo.

condition: Treatment selection on observables only
families_to_avoid_or_flag: OLS causal claims without overlap/balance
notes: Only pre-treatment covariates allowed in treatment model.

condition: Time-to-event outcome with censoring
families_to_avoid_or_flag: linear/logit on event indicator without time-risk justification
notes: Require stset and risk-set audit.

condition: Nested or crossed clusters and random slopes/intercepts are theoretically meaningful
families_to_avoid_or_flag: pooled models without clustered dependence; FE-only if estimand is variance decomposition
notes: Use FE when correlated heterogeneity is key to identification.

condition: Mediation with measured mediator and outcome after treatment
families_to_avoid_or_flag: including mediator as main-model control without total/direct-effect distinction; causal mediation without assumptions; mediate when FE/support unsupported
notes: Run C3a mediation/mechanism checkpoint before final estimator recommendation. Distinguish causal mediation from mechanism evidence.

condition: Interference or network spillovers are central to theory
recommended_family_ids: spatial_network; linear_hdfe with exposure variables; multilevel_mixed if grouped exposure
families_to_avoid_or_flag: standard treatment effect assuming no interference
notes: Define direct/indirect/spillover estimands.

condition: Large candidate control set and causal target with selection-on-observables or nuisance functions
families_to_avoid_or_flag: stepwise p-value control selection
notes: Only include pre-treatment candidate controls.

condition: Fractional DV has many exact zeros or ones
recommended_family_ids: two_part_fractional; fractional_response as robustness; beta_regression only with justified boundary strategy
families_to_avoid_or_flag: betareg without boundary handling; OLS without boundary robustness
notes: Ask user whether boundary values are structural, rounding, non-exposure, missingness, or data errors.

condition: Fractional DV in panel where unit fixed effects are central to identification
recommended_family_ids: fractional_response; linear_hdfe; panel_fe; glm_general as robustness depending on FE feasibility
families_to_avoid_or_flag: pooled fracreg without addressing unit heterogeneity; beta_regression if FE structure is essential and unsupported
notes: Codex must explain tradeoff between bounded-outcome model and FE identification. User must approve the primary route.

condition: One observed mediator with causal mediation estimand and supported outcome/mediator/treatment structure
families_to_avoid_or_flag: sequential_equations as sole causal decomposition; SEM fit-only argument
notes: Require timing/confounding/overlap audit and Stata version check for mediate.

condition: Two mediators with clear parallel or sequential theory and StataNow feature available
families_to_avoid_or_flag: single-mediator mediate repeated without joint path logic; causal claim without mediator ordering
notes: Check if outcome/mediators/treatment match documented two-mediator support.

condition: Latent constructs, multiple indicators, linear path model, measurement model, or group invariance is central
families_to_avoid_or_flag: mediate if latent measurement model is required; observed-variable regressions ignoring measurement error
notes: Causal language requires assumptions beyond SEM fit.

condition: Generalized, nonlinear, multilevel, mixed-response, or random-effects path mediation needed
families_to_avoid_or_flag: sem if generalized links needed; mediate if estimand/support mismatch
notes: Require convergence and scale-specific indirect-effect interpretation.

condition: Panel FE/HDFE/DID identification is central and official mediation commands cannot represent the design
recommended_family_ids: mediation_sequential_equations plus the appropriate base estimator family
families_to_avoid_or_flag: formal causal mediation label unless assumptions and estimands are explicitly defended
notes: Frame as mechanism evidence by default; maintain total-effect model without mediator.
